verdict.summary: Round 2's major finding is resolved coherently: evaluate() now expands template labels in the active per-crate context before de-duplication and routing, so labels such as area:{crate} become crate-specific. The new regression test exercises the real evaluate() path for two added crates and asserts both the expected expanded labels and the absence of unresolved placeholders. The focused PerCrateFanOutTest and CrateIdentityRuleTest suites pass (15 tests). No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the supplied diff.
